name: hundred-million-offers
tagline_zh: 客户嫌贵？别降价，用价值公式+赠品堆叠+风险逆转+稀缺性，把普通报价变成无法拒绝的百万级提案。附赠命名法。
tagline_en: Clients say too pricey? Don't cut—stack value, reverse risk, add scarcity. Turn plain offers into irresistible.
desc_en: Create irresistible offers using the Value Equation, bonus stacking, risk-reversing guarantees, and ethical scarcity. Use when the user mentions "grand slam offer", "make my offer more compelling", "what bonuses should I add", "guarantee strategy", "offer naming", or "people say its too expensive". Also trigger when packaging a product for higher perceived value, justifying premium pricing instead
why_zh: 同类工具只给模板，它教你拆解价值感知的底层机制，连赠品和担保都按心理权重排序，报价像谈判专家附体。
why_en: Unlike template-only tools, it decodes value perception mechanics—bonuses and guarantees ranked by psychological weight—so your.
